data.one_liner: Flutter profiling, debugging and performance tools directly inside the app without an IDE.
data.what_it_does: Provides an in-app devtools menu screen that gives you access to Flutter debugging, profiling, and performance tools without needing to run your app through an IDE. It includes features like highlighting oversized images, showing performance overlays, inspecting layouts, and slowing animations.
use_when: You want to inspect Flutter performance and layout options directly on a device without an IDE.
You need to quickly toggle debug options like performance overlays or layout grids at runtime.
avoid_when: You are looking for logging, crash reporting, or production analytics.
You need fully featured network call monitoring, which is currently on the roadmap rather than fully implemented.
strengths: Allows using Flutter devtools on the go without an IDE.
Bundles various debugging and profiling tools into a ready-to-use menu screen.
weaknesses: Debug features can only be used in debug mode.
Some features have platform limitations or varying behaviors outside of debug mode.
data.setup_notes: Push the DevtoolsMenuScreen in your navigation and optionally wire up DebugOptions in your MaterialApp constructor.
